_comment: The narration, one entry per line, in chapters. `caption` is the burned-in subtitle (what a viewer reads with the sound off); `say` is what the AI voice reads, spelled for pronunciation. Each line's pictures start at the recording mark with the same id (record.mjs). voice.py voices every line into rec/voice/; the timeline reads the durations it writes.

lines.caption: Welcome to Plotline. In the next few minutes, we’ll set up your venue together, from your invite email to a live booking page.
lines.say: Welcome to Plotline. In the next few minutes, we'll set up your venue together, from your invite email to a live booking page.

lines.caption: We’ll use an example venue, Dinkhaus Pickleball. Follow along in your own admin, and pause whenever you need to.
lines.say: We'll use an example venue, Dinkhaus Pickleball. Follow along in your own admin, and pause whenever you need to.

lines.caption: It starts with an email from Plotline, with your venue’s name: “Set up your Plotline account.”
lines.say: It starts with an email from Plotline, with your venue's name. Set up your Plotline account.

lines.caption: Your venue owner guide is attached, if you’d like to read along.
lines.say: Your venue owner guide is attached, if you'd like to read along.

lines.caption: When you’re ready, click Set up your account. The link works once and expires. If it stops working, reply to the email and we’ll send a new one.
lines.say: When you're ready, click, Set up your account. The link works once, and expires. If it stops working, reply to the email, and we'll send a new one.

lines.caption: The link opens your venue’s admin, already signed in. First, choose a password of at least eight characters, and type it twice.
lines.say: The link opens your venue's admin, already signed in. First, choose a password of at least eight characters, and type it twice.

lines.caption: Next time, log in at your venue’s address followed by /admin/login.
lines.say: Next time, you'll log in at your venue's address, followed by slash admin, slash login.

lines.caption: This is your dashboard. At the top is your setup checklist: what players need before they can book.
lines.say: This is your dashboard. At the top is your setup checklist: what players need before they can book.

lines.caption: Your venue stays hidden until you publish it, so take your time. Each Fix button takes you to the right page.
lines.say: Your venue stays hidden until you publish it, so take your time. Each Fix button takes you to the right page.

lines.caption: Let’s start with the courts.
lines.say: Let's start with the courts.

lines.caption: On the Courts page, click Add court. Give it a name, choose the sport, and set its default hourly rate.
lines.say: On the Courts page, click, Add court. Give it a name, choose the sport, and set its default hourly rate.

lines.caption: Add a short description if you like, and click Create court.
lines.say: Add a short description if you like, and click, Create court.

lines.caption: Next, add photos. Players see them on your booking page, and the first photo is the cover.
lines.say: Next, add photos. Players see them on your booking page, and the first photo is the cover.

lines.caption: Add your other courts the same way. Here, Courts 2 and 3.
lines.say: Add your other courts the same way. Here, courts two and three.

lines.caption: Now your opening hours. The Fix button opens Schedule, on the Opening hours tab.
lines.say: Now, your opening hours. The Fix button opens Schedule, on the Opening hours tab.

lines.caption: Set when each day opens and closes, or switch a day off if you’re closed. Here, Monday runs from 7 AM to 11 PM.
lines.say: Set when each day opens and closes, or switch a day off if you're closed. Here, Monday runs from seven A M to eleven P M.

lines.caption: Copy those hours to every day in one click. You can also add a break to any day, like a lunch break.
lines.say: Copy those hours to every day in one click. You can also add a break to any day, like a lunch break.

lines.caption: Nothing changes until you save. Click Review & save, check the changes, then Save changes.
lines.say: Nothing changes until you save. Click, Review and save, check the changes, then, Save changes.

lines.caption: The other tabs can wait: Prices sets rates by day and time, Promos discounts quiet hours, and Closures blocks courts for holidays or repairs.
lines.say: The other tabs can wait. Prices sets rates by day and time, Promos discounts quiet hours, and Closures blocks courts for holidays or repairs.

lines.caption: Next, how players pay you. Payment Setup is under Settings.
lines.say: Next, how players pay you. Payment Setup is under Settings.

lines.caption: Add an account: a label like GCash, the account name and the number.
lines.say: Add an account: a label like G Cash, the account name, and the number.

lines.caption: Add your QR code too. A screenshot of it works. Players scan it in GCash, Maya or their bank app.
lines.say: Add your Q R code too. A screenshot of it works. Players scan it in G Cash, Maya, or their bank app.

lines.caption: Then write your payment instructions. Start from the example, make it your own, and save.
lines.say: Then write your payment instructions. Start from the example, make it your own, and save.

lines.caption: Back on the dashboard, every required step is done. Click Publish venue.
lines.say: Back on the dashboard, every required step is done. Click, Publish venue.

lines.caption: Your booking page is live. To share it, save the QR code in the sidebar. Print it for your front desk, or post it with your link.
lines.say: Your booking page is live. To share it, save the Q R code in the sidebar. Print it for your front desk, or post it with your link.

lines.caption: This is what players see. They pick a free time, pay you, and upload their receipt for you to check.
lines.say: This is what players see. They pick a free time, pay you, and upload their receipt for you to check.

lines.caption: Now let’s look around Settings. It has five sections, and you’ve already used Payment Setup.
lines.say: Now let's look around Settings. It has five sections, and you've already used Payment Setup.

lines.caption: Venue Profile holds your venue’s name and city, your address with a Google Maps link, and your social media links.
lines.say: Venue Profile holds your venue's name and city, your address with a Google Maps link, and your social media links.

lines.caption: Booking Rules decide how many days ahead players can book, how long a slot is held while they pay, and until when they can cancel online.
lines.say: Booking Rules decide how many days ahead players can book, how long a slot is held while they pay, and until when they can cancel online.

lines.caption: Website Appearance sets your colors. Pick a theme, and players see it right away.
lines.say: Website Appearance sets your colors. Pick a theme, and players see it right away.

lines.caption: You can also add a banner for your home page, your logo, and the amenities players look for.
lines.say: You can also add a banner for your home page, your logo, and the amenities players look for.

lines.caption: Policies & Waivers holds the waiver players accept before they book. It’s your venue’s own text, so it’s worth having it checked.
lines.say: Policies and Waivers holds the waiver players accept before they book. It's your venue's own text, so it's worth having it checked.

lines.caption: Last, your day-to-day pages. Once bookings come in, the dashboard shows today’s courts, payments to review, and your earnings.
lines.say: Last, your day to day pages. Once bookings come in, the dashboard shows today's courts, payments to review, and your earnings.

lines.caption: When a player uploads a receipt, open it, check it against your account, and approve it. The booking is confirmed, and the player gets an email.
lines.say: When a player uploads a receipt, open it, check it against your account, and approve it. The booking is confirmed, and the player gets an email.

lines.caption: Bookings lists every booking, with search and filters. From a booking, you can move it or cancel it.
lines.say: Bookings lists every booking, with search and filters. From a booking, you can move it, or cancel it.

lines.caption: Open Play blocks courts for open play sessions, with your details shown on the booking page.
lines.say: Open Play blocks courts for open play sessions, with your details shown on the booking page.

lines.caption: Reports shows this month’s booking fees. Venues pay no setup or monthly fee: players add a ₱10 booking fee to each online booking, and Plotline invoices you monthly for the fees you collected.
lines.say: Reports shows this month's booking fees. Venues pay no setup or monthly fee. Players add a ten peso booking fee to each online booking, and Plotline invoices you monthly for the fees you collected.

lines.caption: That’s your venue, set up and ready for bookings. Want your staff to have their own login? Ask us, and we’ll invite them.
lines.say: That's your venue, set up and ready for bookings. Want your staff to have their own login? Ask us, and we'll invite them.

lines.caption: Questions? Reply to your invite email, or message us on Facebook. We’re happy to help.
lines.say: Questions? Reply to your invite email, or message us on Facebook. We're happy to help.
